qa.label: bill lower
qa.reading_a: If the bill passes as introduced, ČT and ČRo would receive 6.54 bn CZK less (2026 prices) over 2027–2030 than under current law.

qb.ranking: net money income per modified OECD consumption unit (Tab. 3a); consumption quintiles per person
qb.reading_b: Today the poorest tenth of households carries between 0.00 and 5.26 times the share of its income that the richest tenth does (the range is the two exemption bounds; exemptions are counted by entitlement, not by actual take-up). Funded from the state budget at the average tax structure it would be 2.37 times; if the money came from VAT alone it would be 4.81 times, and from personal income tax alone 0.10 times. If the amount is borrowed, current households carry nothing now. Firms and public bodies pay 0.81 bn CZK a year today (what remains of the budgeted fee revenue after households, public bodies included); the schedule of §5 applied to the registered employers gives 1.39 bn CZK (the remainder is 0.58 times that), and the two may differ because not every registered firm is registered for the fee, the remainder includes public bodies (§3(4)) and rental-vehicle fees, and the register counts registered units, not full-time equivalents. After, firms and public bodies would carry 1.98 bn CZK (the corporate-income-tax share of the total); the two figures are not like for like.
qb.debt_scenario: if the amount is borrowed, current households carry nothing now

reading_c.text: Today ČT and ČRo get 9.18 bn CZK a year in fee revenue (2026 budgets). The bill gives 7.808 bn CZK for 2027, which is 1.56 bn CZK (2026 prices) less. Firms and public bodies pay 0.81 bn CZK a year today (what remains of the budgeted fee revenue after households, public bodies included); the schedule of §5 applied to the registered employers gives 1.39 bn CZK (the remainder is 0.58 times that), and the two may differ because not every registered firm is registered for the fee, the remainder includes public bodies (§3(4)) and rental-vehicle fees, and the register counts registered units, not full-time equivalents. After, firms and public bodies would carry 1.98 bn CZK (the corporate-income-tax share of the total); the two figures are not like for like.
